title: Replace JSON Windows With RJV In Algorithms
description: Replace all JSON-rendering windows in compose/algorithms (Kit/Store story and any other) with @microlink/react-json-view. Install the package: npm i @microlink/react-json-view. Swap plain <pre>+JSON.stringify displays in the algorithm story windows (DiffViewer, SnapshotViewer, EventsFeed) with react-json-view for collapsible, readable, theme-aware JSON rendering.
summary: Replaced all JSON-rendering windows in compose/algorithms Kit/Store story with @microlink/react-json-view (rjv). Added the dependency via `npm i @microlink/react-json-view` (hoisted to root node_modules). DiffViewer (forward/result JSON), SnapshotViewer (live/theKit/mat/vcs JSON), and EventsFeed (per-event payload) now render with rjv for collapsible, theme-aware, clickable trees instead of raw `<pre>` + `JSON.stringify`. Added a `useRjvTheme` hook in useKitStore.ts that watches the `dark` class on `<html>` (MutationObserver) and maps to `rjv-default`/`monokai`. Primitive payloads are wrapped in `{ value: ... }` since rjv requires an object root. Error strings in DiffViewer remain `<pre>` since they are not JSON. Also fixed a pre-existing TS7044 implicit-any on `setHandle((prev) => ...)` in useKitStore.ts. Typecheck and eslint pass clean for all modified files. Storybook's unrelated pre-existing vite worker bundling error in compose/js/index.ts (worker.format "iife") is out of scope.
